scenarios.title: Evaluation Metrics Display with Correct Percent Range Formatting
scenarios.purpose: Verify that evaluation metrics with context display precision and recall correctly reflecting the percent ranges after the formatPercentRange function change.

scenarios.title: Load Example Diff and Verify Diff Content
scenarios.purpose: Check that loading the example diff populates the diff textarea with expected content including the 'Invoice not found' error string reflecting any changes from the patch.

scenarios.title: Run Review Button Disabled Without API Ready or Valid Input
scenarios.purpose: Ensure that the 'Analyze change' button remains disabled if API is not ready or required input fields are empty, consistent with patch logic for apiReady state handling.

scenarios.title: Index Repository Context Button Toggle and Message Display
scenarios.purpose: Validate that the 'Index repository context' button toggles disabled state appropriately based on pullRequestUrl input and apiReady state, and status messages update correctly.

scenarios.title: Download Generated Playwright Test Plan Button Availability
scenarios.purpose: Confirm that after successful test plan generation, the download JSON button appears and is clickable, reflecting patch UI changes for test plan presentation.
